before.title: Kangaroo
before.author: Devilmaryart (https://sketchfab.com/Dmary)
before.delivery: Bundled optimized GLB; one local viewer across behaviors
before.biology: Generic artist kangaroo adapted to the red-kangaroo account and photographic references. Taxonomic interpretation, coat variant, proportions and biomechanics need specialist review; not a measured specimen.
before.changes: Replaces the former resting scan in the active viewer with the CC BY 4.0 standing Kangaroo by Devilmaryart. The original source is preserved privately with its checksum; this bundled derivative is simplified (ratio 0.08, error 0.0015), joined into one mesh, and retains creator/license extras and vertex-color variation. Viewer adds a 27-joint limb, tail, head and ear rig and a rufous surface-color interpretation. Hop uses paired hindlimbs, compression/extension and an airborne phase; Slow walk separates paired limb and tail contacts. Forage is a lowered grazing/search posture; food handling and ingestion are absent. Rest is quiet upright support, not sleep. Joint targets, timing, morphology and forces remain unvalidated. The old tobythy scan file remains as a credited legacy asset. v0.5.5: Retained standing artist kangaroo with original area-sampled tapered coat hair. Slow travel now releases both hind soles during recovery while hands and tail support the body; swing/stance sole correction uses continuous clearance. A small trunk-height allowance avoids overextending the front limb chains. Paired Hop, supported grazing/search and upright Rest retain the same 27-joint surface. Generic source species, sex, coat and proportions remain unverified; timing and mechanics are unvalidated.

before.title: Chimpanzee (male)
before.author: Dr. Keith Chan (https://sketchfab.com/chekeichan)
before.delivery: Bundled GLB; one local viewer across behaviors
before.biology: Artist reconstruction; additional viewer articulation is qualitative and unvalidated. See individual action coverage.
before.changes: Original Dr. Keith Chan CC BY 4.0 source GLB and checksum are unchanged. Viewer derivative adds one boundary-preserving subdivision pass, smoothed normals, display color correction, independently authored short hair ribbons and a shared 22-joint skeleton across the source face/body/skin surfaces. Four limb chains and collective MCP/PIP digit articulation support an authored diagonal-sequence knuckle-walking study. Geometric hand/foot contacts, lowered search and a seated rest pose remain qualitative and unvalidated. Hair is generated geometry, not an organism photograph. Finger contacts, grip, feeding, anatomy and timing need expert review. v0.5.3: Retained artist surface with darker differentiated coat/skin and denser tapered hair sampled by surface area. Seated Rest uses forward relaxed supported fingers rather than the walking curl; seated pelvis, hands and feet retain support. Same skeleton and surfaces persist through knuckle walking and search. Individual finger/thumb control, skin anatomy, coat density and trajectories remain unvalidated.

viewerRig.description: Retained artist surface with darker differentiated coat/skin and denser tapered hair sampled by surface area. Seated Rest uses forward relaxed supported fingers rather than the walking curl; seated pelvis, hands and feet retain support. Same skeleton and surfaces persist through knuckle walking and search. Individual finger/thumb control, skin anatomy, coat density and trajectories remain unvalidated.
viewerRig.scope: Raw source bytes and creator/license/checksum are retained. Viewer subdivision, display colors, hair attachments, normalized skin weights and pose targets are credited derivatives; no measured trajectories or forces are imported.
